FinmoAPIKeyCredential.title: Finmo API Key
FinmoAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste your Finmo access key and secret key from the developer settings in your Finmo dashboard. Use keys for the production API. NoClick verifies access by reading your wallets. Payment creation can move money; Finmo controls the permissions on these keys.
